name: Split
action: Separate completion/source validity, donor insertion, genuine host-node excision, reciprocal exchange and mixed donors.

name: Falsify
action: Search nonreal Fourier roots over broad fixed starts; do not equate failed search with no root.

name: Reverse
action: Exchange genuine DH nodes into zeta as well as zeta nodes into DH; same-host recovery remains derived control.

name: Viewpoint
action: Complex source divisors become donor components; host residual amplitude is kept explicit.

name: Visual
action: Save root coordinates and source-node positions for a comparative map.

name: Action
action: Insert, erase, transplant, normalize mass and compare native versus variance-matched donor coordinates.

name: Essentials
action: Keep literal infinite source series, all polynomial terms, reflection and controlled tails; no unspecified physical terms are zeroed.

name: Similar
action: Four arithmetic hosts: zeta, primitive conductor4, primitive real conductor5 and actual Davenport–Heilbronn.

name: Small
action: Empty intervention and single imaginary factor are controls; individual true quartets are discovery probes.

name: Extreme
action: Mixed two-quartet insertion and reciprocal removal/replacement, including known DH off-axis spectral component.

name: Experiment
action: Source-preparation pilot then60digit production,14workers,shared whole-family deadline. Selected observations require100/160digits.

name: Invariant
action: Monitor source reflection, positive real sampled source, completion normalization and exact declared node lists.

name: Monotone
action: Challenge any ordering by donor count or donor imaginary height; compare changes across hosts and matched variance.

name: Weaker bridge
action: Finite local witness/response map only; no unseen-zero exclusion or universal source law.

name: Stronger hunch
action: Existing within-zeta data already rejects context-free donor effects; do not assert a new universal modularity law. Freeze any new law separately after observations.

name: Minimal counterexample
action: Compare each mixed donor with both singles and native versus scaled coordinates.

name: Representation
action: Polynomial insertion equals a constant-coefficient differential operator on completion; reserve that formula for independent validation.

name: Technique
action: Deep corpus source-method search; recent defect-fusion paper prompts retaining host/reflection data. Conductor4 Jacobi product predicts no source nodes, so that search is rejected.

name: Fake proof
action: Positive sources plus matching a few donor zeros need not share spectral zero geometry; the missing step is global residual control.

name: Missing lemma
action: A source-specific composition/attachment law connecting divisor changes to global Fourier zeros.

name: Dependency
action: Verify actual completion -> source -> genuine nodes -> explicit transplanted source -> independently validated spectrum; no shortcut to HB extinction.

name: Nearby false
action: Generic symmetry/moment sufficiency and generic local derivative healing are established or derivable, not discovery targets.

name: Boundary
action: Keep iteration/domain failures, near-real ambiguity, contour poles and absent source certification explicit.

name: Salvage
action: If transplantation fails, locate whether width, residual host or divisor placement carries the distinction; retain the strongest specific counterexample/reconstruction candidate.
